sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Loads React, the icons and the store.

sections.name: GamificationCard (part 1)
sections.title: Level numbers and achievement rules
sections.what: Works out the XP bar percent, total focus minutes, streak days and the count of completed habit check-ins across all habits. Defines four achievements, each with a title, a description, a lock state and an icon.
sections.why: Turns raw activity into the numbers shown on screen.
sections.watch_out: Habit check-ins are counted across all habits, so changing the habit history changes achievement progress.

sections.name: GamificationCard (part 2)
sections.title: Level header, XP bar and badges
sections.what: Draws the level badge, the name, the freeze token count, the XP bar and text, and the four achievement tiles. Locked tiles are dimmed and unlocked tiles are highlighted.
sections.why: Makes progress and unlocked rewards easy to see.
sections.watch_out: Achievement titles and rules are fixed text. Changing a rule means changing both the check and the description.

summary: Shows the user's level, an XP progress bar, streak freeze tokens and four achievement badges that unlock from focus time, habit check-ins and streaks.
purpose: Motivates the user by showing progress and rewards.
why: Likely reason: to encourage consistent habits through visible rewards. The code does not state this.
how: Reads the profile, focus sessions and habits from the store. Works out the XP percent, total focus minutes, streak days and the number of completed habit check-ins. Defines four achievements with unlock rules. Draws the level header, the XP bar, and the badge tiles.
inputs: The profile, focus sessions and habits from the store.
risks: Dividing by a zero XP target gives an invalid number. The XP percent can go above 100 if XP is not reset on level-up. Achievement thresholds are fixed in the code.
debug: If the XP percent looks wrong, check profile xp and xpToNextLevel. If a badge stays locked, check the focus session durations, the habit status values and streakDays.
